build_calculate_runner_subclass: build a subclass of CalculateRunner that implements calculate and write_results methods for a custom ASE calculator
run_calculate_runner: run the CalculateRunner to execute calculations with an ASE calculator and save results to a directory
load_state_from_checkpoint: load a previously saved calculation state from a checkpoint directory to resume an interrupted job
review_calculate_abstract_method: review the abstract calculate method signature and its job_num and num_jobs array job parameters
refactor_write_results_method: refactor the abstract write_results method to support a new output format for calculation results
